question: When and with what substances should the enemy effigy rite be performed?
premises: The rite is timed to the dark fortnight.
The fourteenth lunar day is specified.
Crow and owl fat are used as substances.
inference: The rite should be performed on the fourteenth day of the dark fortnight with materials mixed with crow and owl fat.
uncertainties: The exact items mixed with the fats are implied from the previous verse.
plain_english: On the fourteenth day of the dark fortnight, one should use materials mixed with the fat of a crow and an owl.
